desc: Down-to-earth mall featuring international fashion chains, a food court, a game arcade & a cinema.
addr: Banaswadi Banaswadi, Dodda Banaswadi Main Rd, Jaibharath Nagar, Sathya Nagar, Maruthi Sevanagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560033, India

rev.t: Excellent mall with a great atmosphere. Clean, spacious, and well maintained. Lots of shopping options, good food, and a fun place to spend time with family and friends. The baby care room facility is very useful and well maintained. Highly recommended!

recently visited this mall and had a great experience. It’s spacious, well-designed, and offers a wide variety of attractions. The food court is one of the best I’ve seen, with an impressive range of food stalls offering diverse cuisines. …

Avoid watching movie here. If you are someone who like to throw money then this is the place for you. If you are someone who have more respect for money then this is absolutely not the place for you. Mall and premises are well maintained …
